plan.title: Child Development: Baseline vs Endline
plan.subtitle: Improvement metrics by location and coach

panels.title: Total children tracked
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT "Child ID" FROM baseline UNION SELECT "Child ID" FROM endline) AS all_children

panels.title: Avg height gain by location
panels.sql: SELECT base."Location", ROUND(AVG(end."Height cm" - base."Height cm"), 1) AS avg_height_gain FROM baseline AS base JOIN endline AS end ON base."Child ID" = end."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Avg sit-ups gain by location
panels.sql: SELECT base."Location", ROUND(AVG(end."Sit ups" - base."Sit ups"), 1) AS avg_situps_gain FROM baseline AS base JOIN endline AS end ON base."Child ID" = end."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Avg height gain by coach
panels.sql: SELECT base."Coach", ROUND(AVG(end."Height cm" - base."Height cm"), 1) AS avg_height_gain FROM baseline AS base JOIN endline AS end ON base."Child ID" = end."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Avg sit-ups gain by coach
panels.sql: SELECT base."Coach", ROUND(AVG(end."Sit ups" - base."Sit ups"), 1) AS avg_situps_gain FROM baseline AS base JOIN endline AS end ON base."Child ID" = end."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 locations by overall improvement
panels.sql: SELECT base."Location", ROUND(AVG(end."Height cm" - base."Height cm"), 1) AS avg_height_gain, ROUND(AVG(end."Sit ups" - base."Sit ups"), 1) AS avg_situps_gain FROM baseline AS base JOIN endline AS end ON base."Child ID" = end."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This dashboard compares baseline and endline measurements for children across different locations and coaches. The total number of unique children tracked is {{p1}}. On average, children in the top-performing locations gained {{p2.avg_height_gain}} cm in height and {{p3.avg_situps_gain}} sit-ups. When looking at coaches, the highest height gain was {{p4.avg_height_gain}} cm, while the best sit-ups improvement was {{p5.avg_situps_gain}}. The table highlights the top 10 locations based on these combined metrics.
